_: One row per component kind, keyed by the data it edits. Names on the right must exist in the scan or build.mjs fails. Unity names win where they exist.

MultiChoice.note: Inside an ActionBar it takes the text form by itself; a control's own props still win. Vertical, joined, tabs, fit and scroll make a rail of kinds: rows share its height, the chosen row's indicator slides, and an option's own style draws a line at its edge. ModuleGroups is the text form for a tab's groups, and inline it sits on a row of its own controls, such as a band's tag.

Boolean.note: Forms: cell, setting, switch. Open: is it a Cycle form in Unity, which has no enum entry but does have SynthBooleanShader?

Knob.note: Forms: classic, thin outline, cut-out indicator; range as DualTickRangeKnob.

Slider.note: Forms: cell, thin line, setting, range, progress. The thin form shares cell drag and value behavior. Progress is a readonly weighted distribution on the rounded Synth track; consumers own segment labels, colors and activity.

RenderTextureView.note: Browser GLB presentation uses /preview3d and the complete view uses /preview3d/react; state evaluation and native camera adapters stay with their owners.

Connection.note: The gutter threads and the baseball advantage borders are the same idea.

Container.note: Modal has a titled form: its title, ModalRow rows on two shared columns and an actions row that stays in view while the rows scroll.

ActionBar.data: the current actors and their state
ActionBar.note: Web-first. Optional notice shows feedback beneath the header with action-label typography and an optional recovery action. Reaches C# once promoted in the language.

Crossfade.data: one visible pane at a time
Crossfade.note: Compact form fades peer panes. The page form retains a controlled keyed stack, state and scroll; push and Back slide between pages. Callers own routes, guards and deactivating effects on hidden pages. The card-flip motion helper turns retained module surfaces in place; consumers own navigation and visible layers.

Text.note: Single-line, multiline and credential fields use the same text control. Native input attributes retain browser password-manager and validation behavior.
